scripture.verse: "And it came to pass, after the year was expired, at the time when kings go forth to battle, that Da vid sent Joab and his servants with him and all Israel. And they destroyed the children of Amnion and besieged Rabbah. But David tarried still at Jerusalem."
"For the Lord's portion is His people."

sermons.title: Sermon 452 | The Lord's Care Of His People

scripture.verse: "And they say unto Him, We have here but five loaves and two fishes. He said, Bring them here to Me."

sermons.title: Sermon 455 | "The Love Of Jesus—What It Is—None But His Loved Ones Know"

scripture.verse: "And to know the love of Christ which passes knowledge."
"I will take away the stony heart out of your flesh, and I will give you an heart of flesh."
"For it is not a vain thing for you, because it is your life."
"He was numbered with the transgressors; and he bare the sin of many, and made intercession for the transgressors."

sermons.title: Sermon 459 | A Sermon For Men Of Taste

scripture.verse: "Therefore laying aside all malice and all guile and hypocrisies, and envies and all evil speaking, as newborn babes, desire the sincere milk of the Word, that you may grow thereby. If, indeed, you have tasted that the Lord is gracious."
